system.summary: System A: homophonic substitution on numbers 1 to about 74 among clear Dutch, the same table in 1623, 1634, 1640 and 1643 (KEY_v2). System B: a mixed table where letters and numbers both stand for plain letters (a number in B does not have its A value), used for names, places, goods and amounts; Roman numerals as code words (XXI silver, IV gold).
system.notes: Word division: kept with / in 1623-1640 copies; the 1643 copy 2 writes / between every number (a DP word rule was frozen before decoding). distinct_symbols approximate.

prior_solution.where: Contemporary decipherments: 1623 margins (inv. 1079), 1634 glosses (inv. 1108), 1640 interlinear (inv. 1134 scans 605, 617), 1643 interlinear (inv. 1141 scans 886, 890). Not printed: Coolhaas GM I-II print none of the deciphered words; the purpose of the 1643 Vries voyage is printed in the Dagh-Register 1643-44. Cyphersolver issues/PRs/catalogue, DECODE (only 1564, Ramanacoil 1674), HistoCrypt papers: nothing on these ciphers.

solution.what: Coolhaas GM I-II full-text grep (1,676 pages) for cipher notes: only 25 Dec 1623 and 7 Mar 1643 marked.
Blind HTR detector over NA 1.04.02 inv. 1070-1145 (values never printed, masked triage): cipher found in 1623, 1634 copies (training), 9 Sep 1640 (inv. 1134), Jan 1643 and Mar 1643 (inv. 1141).
Selection rule frozen (20:35:18 UTC); 9 Sep 1640 chosen as first non-training candidate; base copy 583 chosen from illegible thumbnails.
Scan 583 transcribed from the full image and frozen with method, decoder, scorer and key (20:58:51 UTC); second pass 57/57 groups.
Decoded once with KEY_v2 (frozen 20:10:20 UTC from the 1634 glosses and 1623 context). Coverage 55/57 = 96.49%; 9/11 tokens = 81.82% in the wordlist.
5,000 shuffled keys at seed 20261112: 0 >= 9 (max 3); 5,000 at seed 7: 0 >= 9 (max 3).
After the score: the interlinear decipherment in scan 617 agrees where legible; gives 12 = b and the blotted group 57 = m.

Reserve sibling Jan 1643 (inv. 1141 scan 901): unglossed copy writes '/' between every number group, so the frozen sign convention cannot segment words; mixed with a letter code. Not scored. Superseded later the same day: a DP word rule was frozen and the letter scored (below).
1643 copy 2 (inv. 1141 scans 901, 902, 905, 906) transcribed from max images; method with a dynamic-programming word rule frozen 21:09:15 UTC, transcription 21:13:20 UTC; both stamped (RFC 3161).
1643 decoded once with KEY_v2: coverage 82/86 = 95.35%; 59/86 groups = 68.60% covered by dictionary words.
1643: 5,000 shuffled keys at seed 20261112 and 7: 0 >= 59 (max 48, 45); 5,000 shuffled ciphertexts (matched control) at each seed: 0 >= 59 (max 54, 55).
1643 copy 1 interlinear gloss opened after the stamp: agrees on 10 of 12 checkable runs; 'voor' vs gloss 'naer'; '24 39 17 30 16 5 50 20' glossed 'eylanden' (system B).
LC_KEY_v1 (12 letters) built from 1643 glosses (Tartarien, Chinees, natien, Japan, oosten, acht ...), frozen 21:16:17 UTC.
LC_KEY_v1 applied once to the 13 letter-cipher words of 1640: 5/13 = 38.46%; key shuffles 9/5,000 and 12/5,000; letter shuffles 96/5,000 and 118/5,000. Fails the bar.
HTR detectors over inv. 1146-1200 (83 pages flagged, masked triage: none cipher) and an LC-string detector over 1070-1200 (new: cipher in the body of the 1640 letter, inv. 1134 scans 570 and 605).
System B identified from glosses: numbers in B have other values (2 = t, 12 = o, 16 = n, 24 = e ...), mixed with letters; KEY_B_v1 frozen 21:20:27 UTC. No held-out test.
HistoCrypt (Ramanacoil 1674), Dagh-Register 1640-41 and 1643-44 OCR, GM II pp. 194-195, Cyphersolver issues/PRs/catalogue: no print of the deciphered words.

outcome.method_basis: Figures of record: 1640 postscript 9/11 tokens = 81.82%; 1643 59/86 groups = 68.60% (DP word rule frozen in advance); 1623 32/54 = 59.26% (below bar). Key shuffles 0/5,000 at seeds 20261112 and 7 for all three; matched ciphertext-shuffle control 0/5,000 at both seeds for 1643. Contemporary interlinear decipherments agree where checked (after the scores). System B read only from glosses. docs/_validate.py not run. fraction_read = system-A groups given a KEY_v2 value on the first passes: (254 + 217 + 55 + 82) / (276 + 217 + 57 + 86) = 608/636 = 0.956 (1623, 1634, 1640 postscript, 1643; 1634 is the key source). Blind second readings (isolated AI readers, images only, frozen and stamped before alignment): 1640 postscript 56/57 = 98.25% of number groups agree (only difference the blotted group, reader '57?', matching the scan 617 gloss); 1643 85/86 = 98.84% (one disagreement, 902.4 group 3: 10 vs 16, a listed doubt; 3 extra reader numbers are signs frozen inside letter-cipher words). Figures of record unchanged. No person has checked any reading.
